**Kind of proposal**

- [ ] New licence policy pack (`policies/licences/<SPDX-ID>.yml`)
- [ ] Change to an existing licence policy pack
- [ ] New jurisdiction pack (`jurisdictions/<slug>/framework.yml`)
- [ ] Change to an existing jurisdiction pack
- [ ] Other (`schemas/` or related contract change)
